05 — FAQ

Before you ask

How do I book?

Send a WhatsApp message using any book button on this page, or DM @yalla_hbibi on Instagram. Booking is open 24/7.

What can I book?

Private yacht charters, yacht parties, birthdays & events, and VIP trips — including F1 Abu Dhabi experiences during race weekends.

How do I get prices and availability?

In the chat. Message us on WhatsApp with the experience you want and your date — that is where prices and availability are shared, exactly as the feed has always done it: DM for more details and booking.

Can I see more before I decide?

The feed is the catalogue: 5,283 posts of real charters, parties and trips on @yalla_hbibi. Scroll it, pick your moment, then message us.
